item.title: Bruce Schneier: Formal Verification of the Signal Protocol Using AI
item.description: DeepMind's AlphaProof Code used agentic AI to formally verify Signal's crypto guarantees — 6M+ lines of Lean in four weeks, and it caught known bugs in older Signal versions.

item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: Jensen Huang Really Liked Selling China Advanced AI Chips
item.description: The Jensen scandal's real story: years of Nvidia lobbying against export controls, and the new remote-access rule finally closing the loophole — Megaspeed still received $800M in chips after being put on a no-sell list.
